facebookresearch_flsim/flsim/reducers/ba.create_round_reducer: create a RoundReducer instance with a global model to aggregate client updates in federated learning

facebookresearch_flsim/flsim/reducers/dp.create_dp_round_reducer: create a DPRoundReducer instance with a global model, users per round, and total users for DP federated learning

facebookresearch_flsim/flsim/reducers/dp.reduce_with_dp_noise: reduce client updates by summing weights, adding calibrated noise, and broadcasting the noisy model to all workers
facebookresearch_flsim/flsim/reducers/dp.get_privacy_budget: get the current privacy budget spent by the DP round reducer after aggregation rounds
facebookresearch_flsim/flsim/reducers/dp.reset_dp_round_reducer: reset the DP round reducer with a new reference model and reattach the privacy engine

facebookresearch_flsim/flsim/reducers/we.build_weighted_dp_reducer: build a WeightedDPRoundReducer instance with a global model, num users per round, and total users for weighted DP federated learning
facebookresearch_flsim/flsim/reducers/we.create_weighted_dp_config: create a WeightedDPRoundReducerConfig dataclass with min_weight, max_weight, mean_weight, and estimator_type settings for weighted DP reduction
facebookresearch_flsim/flsim/reducers/we.test_sensitivity_calculation: test the sensitivity method of WeightedDPRoundReducer to calculate DP sensitivity using unbiased or biased estimator types
facebookresearch_flsim/flsim/reducers/we.review_clamp_weight: review the clamp_weight method to ensure client weights are clamped between min_weight and max_weight boundaries
facebookresearch_flsim/flsim/reducers/we.refactor_biased_estimator: refactor the _biased_estimator method to apply weight modifier via linear combination and return biased sensitivity value
